press_references.value: Egypt, Algeria sign MoU on crude oil supply to strengthen energy security and regional integration

partnership_announcements.description: Egyptian General Petroleum Corporation and Algeria’s Sonatrach signed an MoU establishing a framework for Egypt to purchase Algerian crude oil, aimed at securing Egypt’s supply and reinforcing its role as a regional energy hub.

press_references.value: Egypt, Italy’s Eni sign deal to support New Heliopolis Hospital development

partnership_announcements.description: Egyptian General Petroleum Corporation, the General Authority for Health Insurance, and Italian energy company Eni signed an MoU to cooperate on developing New Heliopolis Hospital and upgrading healthcare infrastructure as part of Eni's CSR efforts.

press_references.value: Egypt inks protocol to treat petroleum waste, increase returns from natural resources

partnership_announcements.description: Egyptian General Petroleum Corporation signed a cooperation protocol with Nuclear Materials Authority under which NMA will treat petroleum waste and help extract economic value from natural resources, supporting Egypt’s environmental and resource‑optimization goals.

press_references.value: $44m allocated to upgrading Egypt Upstream Gateway under extended agreement with SLB

partnership_announcements.description: EGPC and SLB extended their Egypt Upstream Gateway contract for three years, committing about $44 million to upgrade the platform’s digital capabilities.
